subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The tree had always given shade, but the bench gave people a reason to stay.”?
options: Sometimes losing one small comfort helps people find other ways to use time.
Sometimes an object becomes important because of the feelings people leave there.
Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.
Sometimes a place changes not because it becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop.
